description: The file 'platformcapsdata.cpp' contains implementation code related to platform capabilities data within the RDK project. It includes functions for retrieving device properties, RFC parameters, MIME types, plugin information, and various feature checks, along with configuration management and feature extraction logic.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Class providing access to platform capability data, including device features, quirks, supported MIME types, plugins, and browser info.

methods.name: AddDashExclusionList
methods.description: Adds DASH playback exclusions based on RFC and device properties.

methods.name: GetQuirks
methods.description: Returns a list of quirks applicable to the current platform based on environment variables and compile-time flags.

methods.name: GetBrowser
methods.description: Retrieves the browser information (type, version, user agent) based on configuration files.

methods.name: SupportsTrueSD
methods.description: Indicates whether TrueSD is supported, based on compilation flags.

methods.name: CanMixPCMWithSurround
methods.description: Checks if PCM audio can be mixed with surround sound, querying device ports.

methods.name: GetFirmwareUpdateDisabled
methods.description: Determines if firmware updates are disabled by checking the presence of the update configuration file.

methods.name: DeviceCapsFeatures
methods.description: Returns a map of device capabilities/features, including support for HTML features, plugins, codecs, and quirks.

methods.name: GetMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types (currently placeholder).

methods.name: getAvailablePlugins
methods.description: Loads plugin configurations from files and determines available plugins.

methods.name: verifyLibraries
methods.description: Checks if specified plugin libraries exist on the filesystem.
